Cần hỏi nghiệp vụ xem thỏa thuận có bao gồm Lô lẻ không?
T1 : Negotiation (regular) => Hai bên tự deal giá + khối lượng, không cần theo giá thị trường, không vào hệ thống khớp lệnh
Ví dụ: Bạn bán cho bạn mình 1 triệu cổ phiếu thì 2 bên tự deal giá
T4 : Negotiation (regular for Odd lot) => giống T1 nhưng cho lô lẻ (odd lot)
T2 : Negotiation (pre) => Giống T1 nhưng thỏa thuận trước giờ mở cửa
T3 : Negotiation (post) => Giống T1 nhưng thỏa thuận sau giờ giao dịch
T6 : Negotiation (post for Odd lot) => Giống T1 nhưng thỏa thuận sau giờ cho lô lẻ
Lô lẻ là không đủ 100 cổ phiếu

column5: KLNN mua − KLNN bán
column17:
Trade_HOSE: 
kl_nn_mua: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Buy - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20')) 
kl_nn_ban: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Sell - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20')) 
Trade_HNX: 
kl_nn_mua: Trade quantity (điều kiện: Buy Foreign Investor Type Code type IN ('10','20')) 
kl_nn_ban: Trade quantity (điều kiện: Sell Foreign Investor Type Code IN ('10','20'))
column18: Market ID in (UPX,STX,STO)
column19:
SELECT
t.[Issue Code] AS symbol,
t.[Trade date] AS ngay_gd,
1. HNX:
-- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,

-- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,

-- KLNN ròng = mua - bán
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_rong

FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX') -- HNX niêm yết + UPCOM, loại trừ DVX/BDX/HCX
GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date];
2.HOSE
SELECT
t.Symbol,
t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,

-- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,

-- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,

-- KLNN ròng = mua - bán
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_rong

FROM Trade_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO' 
GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date];
column20:
Trade_HOSE:
kl_nn_mua: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Buy - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20'))
kl_nn_ban: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Sell - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20'))
Trade_HNX:
-- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)

-- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')

THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_rong

FROM Trade_HNX t

ON t.Symbol = idx.symbol

-- Tỷ lệ KLGD / KLGDTB 5 ngày
WITH daily_kl AS (

WITH daily_kl AS (

),
klgd_today AS (

ORDER BY ty_le_5ngay DESC;

column5: Khối lượng NĐTNN mua
column17:
Trade_HOSE:

Trade_HNX:

column18: Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20')
column19:
-- KL mua NN toàn thị trường — xếp hạng Top mua
WITH kl_nn AS (
-- HOSE
SELECT
t.Symbol AS symbol,
t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban
FROM Trade_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO'

UNION ALL

-- HNX + UPCOM
SELECT
t.[Issue Code] AS symbol,
t.[Trade date] AS ngay_gd,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
)
SELECT
symbol,
ngay_gd,
SUM(kl_nn_mua) AS kl_nn_mua,
SUM(kl_nn_ban) AS kl_nn_ban,
SUM(kl_nn_mua) - SUM(kl_nn_ban) AS kl_nn_rong
FROM kl_nn
GROUP BY symbol, ngay_gd
ORDER BY kl_nn_mua DESC -- Xếp hạng Top mua NN
LIMIT :top_n;"

-- ================================================================
-- GT TỔ CHỨC TRONG NƯỚC RÒNG (HOSE + HNX/UPCOM)
-- Tổ chức trong nước = tổ chức + Foreign Investor Type = '00'

WITH to_chuc_tn AS (

-- ----------------------------------------------------------
-- HOSE
-- Tổ chức trong nước: Invest Type IN (2000-6000 series)
-- Loại trừ: cá nhân (1000,1100,1200,8000)
-- nước ngoài (7000,7100,7200)
-- không xác định (9000)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
t.Symbol AS ma_ck,
t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Invest Type] IN (
'2000','2100','2200', -- Bảo hiểm
'3000','3100','3200','3300', -- Quỹ đầu tư
'4000', -- Ngân hàng
'5000','5100','5200', -- CTCK
'6000') -- Tổ chức khác
THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Invest Type] IN (
'2000','2100','2200',
'3000','3100','3200','3300',
'4000',
'5000','5100','5200',
'6000')
THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
FROM Trade_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO'
GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date]

UNION ALL

-- ----------------------------------------------------------
-- HNX / UPCOM
-- Tổ chức trong nước: investor classification code <> '8000'
-- AND Foreign Investor Type = '00'
-- HNX code: 1000=CTCK, 2000=Bảo hiểm, 3000=Quỹ,
-- 4000=Ngân hàng, 5000=Tài chính, 6000=Hưu trí,
-- 7000/7100=Tổ chức NN → loại qua Foreign code='00'
-- ----------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
t.[Issue Code] AS ma_ck,
t.[Trade date] AS ngay_gd,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy investor classification code] <> '8000'
AND t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] = '00'
THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
* CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell investor classification code] <> '8000'
AND t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] = '00'
THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
* CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date]
)
SELECT
ma_ck,
ngay_gd,
SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_tochuc_tn_mua,
SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_tochuc_tn_ban,
SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_tochuc_tn_rong
FROM to_chuc_tn
GROUP BY ma_ck, ngay_gd
ORDER BY ABS(SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban)) DESC;

column3: Giao dịch & thanh khoản
column17:
Trade_HOSE:
kl_nn_mua: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Buy - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20'))
kl_nn_ban: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Sell - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20'))
Trade_HNX:
kl_nn_mua: Trade quantity (điều kiện: Buy Foreign Investor Type Code type IN ('10','20'))
kl_nn_ban: Trade quantity (điều kiện: Sell Foreign Investor Type Code IN ('10','20'))
column18: Market ID in (UPX,STX,STO)
column19:
SELECT
t.[Issue Code] AS symbol,
t.[Trade date] AS ngay_gd,
1. HNX:
-- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,

-- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,

-- KLNN ròng = mua - bán
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_rong

FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX') -- HNX niêm yết + UPCOM, loại trừ DVX/BDX/HCX
GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date];
2.HOSE
SELECT
t.Symbol,
t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,

-- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,

-- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,

-- KLNN ròng = mua - bán
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_rong

FROM Trade_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO' 
GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date];

-- GT tự doanh ròng (HOSE + HNX)
WITH tu_doanh AS (
-- HOSE
SELECT t.Symbol AS ma_ck, t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Client/House Classification Code]='30'
THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Client/House Classification Code]='30'
THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
FROM Trade_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date]=:ngay_gd AND t.[Market ID]='STO'
GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date]

UNION ALL

-- HNX / UPCOM
SELECT t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date],
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy client/house classification]='30'
THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
* CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell client/house classification]='30'
THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
* CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date]=:ngay_gd AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date]
)
SELECT ma_ck, ngay_gd,
SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_tudoanh_mua,
SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_tudoanh_ban,
SUM(gt_mua)-SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_tudoanh_rong
FROM tu_doanh
GROUP BY ma_ck, ngay_gd;
